verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners have essentially the same layout. The logo and a tiny can sit at the left, the headline wraps with 'fizz' orphaned on its own line, and the CTA sits at the right with three lines of legal text under it at about 4px, which is unreadable. The can is shrunk to a meaningless icon, and the teal circle crowds the CTA in the top-right corner. B's CTA sits slightly closer to the top edge and its legal text wraps a little more tightly, but the difference is negligible.
